const int MAX_N = 1000009;
const long long MOD = 1000000007LL;

    long long result = 1;
    base %= mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % mod;
        base = (base * base) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int p, k;

            answer = (answer * p) % MOD;
        }
        cout << answer << '\n';
        return 0;

        if (visited[i]) continue;

        int cycleLength = 0;
        
        do {
            visited[current] = 1;
            cycleLength++;
            current = (1LL * current * k) % p;
        } while (!visited[current]);
        
        if (modPow(k, cycleLength, p) == 1) {
            answer = (answer * p) % MOD;
        }
    }
    
    cout << answer << '\n';
    return 0;
